summary: Decompose supply-chain inventory, attestation, policy verification, and custody projection behind the existing facade.
details: Preserves all 28 public PowerShell function names and their declaration order.
Keeps source identity, archive selection, component inventory, SPDX, SLSA provenance, policy verification, and custody-record behavior unchanged.
Completes the bounded PowerShell decomposition sequence and leaves bridge retirement and private four-target MIR 4.1 qualification as separate required fixed points.
Regenerates the package-excluded platform lock and dependent reference projections after the module authority changes.
Changes no player package, gameplay, save, setting, migration, compatibility claim, version, tag, signature, seal, or publication gate.
